Use this information to enhance the draft.

The subHeading of this template can be modified or changed to something related to the instructions, eg 'APPLICATION FOR THE ISSUANCE OF (CMC) NOTICE FORM 17', 'NOTICE OF INTENTION TO DEFEND' etc.

The role is 'Claimant & Defendant', use if not specify.

If user provides a subHeading, use it. {{subHeading}}

Other relevant information: {{information}}.

Draft should be short and direct. eg for notice to defend 'TAKE NOTICE that Mr abraham okoro, the defendant in this suit, intends to defend the suit at the hearing.', for CMC notice 'I hereby apply for the issuance of form 17 in the above-named suit.'.

The draft should be within 100-5000 words.

Use today's date to fill the date section.
